name: Emre Yilmaz
bio:
Emre Yilmaz joined Akkodis ASP Team after a somewhat unconventional route into motorsport. Initially pursuing a degree in economics, he found himself drawn to the strategic and branding aspects of racing during a university project on motorsport sponsorships. He transitioned to marketing, driven by a passion for connecting fans with the thrill and drama of racing. 

Emre's approach to marketing is deeply pragmatic, focusing on data-driven decisions and measurable results. He believes in leveraging innovative strategies to enhance brand visibility and foster genuine engagement with the racing community. His experience balancing academic rigor with real-world application gives him a unique perspective on driving impactful campaigns. 

 What sets Emre apart is his commitment to perfectionism combined with a remarkable speed of execution. He's not afraid to challenge conventional marketing practices and is always seeking opportunities to optimize and refine campaigns for maximum effectiveness. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, making him a valuable asset to Akkodis ASP.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Emre has a sharp, focused gaze and a confident posture.
